metadata.formula: g_j(x)=(\kappa+1)x_j/2-(\kappa-1)(O_jx_j+O_j^\top x_j)/4,\quad f_A(x)=\langle x,Ax\rangle/2;\qquad A_\kappa=(\kappa-1)A_2-(\kappa-2)I,\quad A_2x=(A_\kappa x+(\kappa-2)x)/(\kappa-1).
metadata.mechanism: Known exact algebra reconstructs a centered symmetric quadratic value/gradient observation from the stronger or affine-related oracle replies and the known query. B1 uses two forward/transpose primitive replies per block; Remark4.2 uses one precision-matvec reply in either direction through the same unknown rotation. This is a comparison of source oracle-factorization mechanisms, not an identification of their priors, targets or indistinguishability lemmas.
metadata.hypothesis_map: Common layer: finite real Euclidean coordinates, exact matvec/value/gradient oracle, known scalar parameters, actual centered potential x^T A x/2, and each source family symmetric positive definite. B1:3<=n<=d,kappa>=4,k=floor(d/n), actual orthogonal tuple and contiguous residual identity; forward/transpose primitives have distinct per-block counting. Remark4.2:d>=2,kappa>=2, deterministic cosine spectrum, SAME unknown O for A2 and Akappa, known kappa-1>0; spectrum may be given while O remains hidden. Main-bound ranges remain different: sign d>=1,kappa>=4,epsilon<=1/16; fixed spectrum fixed delta in(0,1),d sufficiently large,2<=kappa<=d^(1-delta),0<epsilon<=1/10.
metadata.conclusion_map: The two source identities organize exact query-reply reconstruction with explicitly different oracle roles/overheads. The current new Lean target establishes only actual B1 one-query calculus/reconstruction; operational finite-horizon2T caps and randomized transcript lifting are still open. The fixed-spectrum affine identity is source-only here. No determinant-sign theorem implies a fixed-spectrum theorem, no sample-law/TV or epsilon transport follows from reply equivalence, and no expected-cost comparison is certified.
metadata.failure_boundary: Noisy or finite-precision replies need new error-amplification/TV adapters; arithmetic/bit costs are not query counts. Unknown center/additive constant changes value recovery. The affine reverse conversion fails at kappa=1 and requires the same latent O, not independently rotated matrices. First-order T, per-block2T and total2Tk are different budget units; the source worst-case every-input/every-seed cap is not an expected budget. Known spectrum belongs to the eigenbasis route; covariance A^-1 and Gaussian targets change under the affine precision map, so sampling accuracy cannot be transferred without a separate proved target adapter. No posterior/Krylov equivalence or growing fixed-spectrum log(1/epsilon) term is implied.
